department: Niels Bohr Institute (Faculty of SCIENCE PhD School)

deadline.value: No central deadline: apply to advertised PhD positions on the UCPH job portal (each has its own deadline); applications go through the relevant department
deadline.quote: All applications for enrolment go through the relevant department at SCIENCE.

also.quote: Look for advertised PhD positions at the University's job portal.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: You must have an agreement with a principal supervisor at the Faculty of Science before you apply for admission
supervisor.quote: You must have a principal supervisor employed at one of the departments at the Faculty of Science, and you must have an agreement with your supervisor before you apply for admission.

also.quote: Applicants must have an agreement with a principal supervisor.

funding.value: No unfunded admission: you need funding for salary and tuition fee to enrol (usually employment as a PhD fellow); UCPH stopped admitting self-paying PhD students in May 2025
funding.quote: To be enrolled as a PhD student, the applicant must have funding for salary and tuition fee. | Employment as a PhD fellow at the faculty

also.quote: UCPH wants transparency in the funding of all research at UCPH and will not receive self-paying PhD students as of May 2025.

entry_route.value: Qualifications equivalent to a Danish two-year master's degree (120 ECTS); most students enter via the 5+3 route (an integrated 3+5 route also exists)
entry_route.quote: Admission to the PhD programme is based on qualifications equivalent to a Danish two-year master's degree (120 ECTS).

also.quote: The majority of PhD students are admitted through the 5+3 entry, allowing 3 years of full-time PhD studies. | INTEGRATED PHD PROGRAMME (3+5)

notes: Rules are from the Faculty of SCIENCE PhD School, which covers NBI (no separate NBI English admissions page was found). The PhD lasts three years after a master's. From 1 Jan 2027 UCPH charges a PhD tuition fee of DKK 85,000 per year for three years, which your funding must cover (phd.ku.dk enrolment page). Check each job ad for extra requirements.
